newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy rises, no reason seen.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy rises, no reason seen.

text.p: Consumer electronics firm Best Buy Co Inc rose 9.9 percent on Monday and company officials said they knew of no reason for the increase.
Shares in the consumer electronics retailer rose 1-1/4 to 13-7/8 in early afternoon trade. Volume was 680,600 shares.
"There's no company announcement," a Best Buy spokeswoman said. She added that Best Buy would release sales figures for the third quarter and November on Thursday.
Terrence McEvoy, an analyst at Janny Montgomery Scott, said he also knew no reason for the rise.
"It's not like they were selling a lot of computers over the weekend," he said. "In general the retailers aren't doing too well today."
